definitions.explanation: A child of emigrants, born in the new country, especially a Japanese emigrant's child ({日系|にっけい}{二世|にせい}).
Used after a name for a monarch or a son who has the same name or takes over the same role: エリザベス{二世|にせい}, or {二世|にせい}{議員|ぎいん}, a politician who inherited a parent's seat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日系|にっけい}→日系：12956_nikkei⟧{二世|にせい}。
examples.english: A second-generation person of Japanese descent.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ブラジル→ブラジル：31001_burajiru⟧⟦{生|う}まれ→生まれ：01867_umare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日系|にっけい}→日系：12956_nikkei⟧{二世|にせい}だ。
examples.english: He is a second-generation Japanese Brazilian, born in Brazil.

examples.japanese: {二世|にせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{多|おお}く⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧だ。
examples.english: Many children of emigrants are better at the language of the country they live in than at their parents' language.

examples.japanese: エリザベス{二世|にせい}。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{父親|ちちおや}→父親：03469_chichioya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{地盤|じばん}→地盤：04035_jiban⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{継|つ}いだ→継ぐ：02292_tsugu⟧{二世|にせい}⟦{議員|ぎいん}→議員：02660_giin⟧だ。
examples.english: He is a second-generation politician who inherited his father's constituency.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧で、「{二世|にせい}⟦タレント→タレント：25367_tarento⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれる→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{嫌|いや}がっている→嫌がる：03041_iyagaru⟧。
examples.english: He is the son of a famous actor and hates being called a "second-generation celebrity".

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{日系|にっけい}→日系：12956_nikkei⟧{二世|にせい}: second-generation person of Japanese descent (born abroad to Japanese emigrants)
- {二世|にせい}⟦{議員|ぎいん}→議員：02660_giin⟧: politician who inherited a parent's seat
- {二世|にせい}⟦タレント→タレント：25367_tarento⟧ / {二世|にせい}⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧: celebrity / actor child of a famous parent

RELATED WORDS:
- {一世|いっせい}: first generation; the First
- {三世|さんせい}: third generation; the Third

WATCH OUT:
{二世|にせい}⟦{議員|ぎいん}→議員：02660_giin⟧ and {二世|にせい}⟦タレント→タレント：25367_tarento⟧ often carry a critical nuance of inherited privilege.
